findings.evidence: `norm_qVector_le` at line 122; its sole use is line 332 inside `hint`. `twoParticleCorrelation` (line 138) has only `_def`, `_eq_sum`, `_neg`, `_add_const` — no order lemma. ‖Q‖² ≤ M² gives (M²−M)/(M(M−1)) = 1.

findings.issue: `norm_qVector_le` is exported but its only in-file use is the integrability bound at line 332; the derived observable `twoParticleCorrelation` carries no bound. §5.2 defines `vn{2}` as `√⟨2⟩`, so a consumer needing `⟨2⟩ ≤ 1` must unfold `twoParticleCorrelation` and redo the division estimate.

summary: Bodies are correctly unexposed, the simp set is coherent, and there is no compatibility surface, but the characteristic API is incomplete: no integrability/measurability lemmas are exported for `qVector` or `twoParticleCorrelation` (all three are built inline and thrown away), and `norm_qVector_le` is never transported to a bound on `twoParticleCorrelation`.
